paragraphs: PreCise MRM sells an AVL (Automatic Vehicle Location) solution for fleet management. The pages describe telematics that track current vehicle location and produce a complete fleet summary at the end of the day. Collected data runs from location and speed to the activity of vehicle accessories.

The solutions page groups this into asset management, driver management, compliancy, material use, reports, integrations and fleet electrification. Driver management monitors speeding and hard breaking for driver coaching. Compliancy covers hours logged, hours of service (HOS) status and pre-trip and post-trip inspections. Material use reporting covers fuel and winter road material. The fleet electrification section offers an EV suitability assessment and a charging station number assessment.

The devices page lists the IX-403-G, the IX-101-G, the IX-84 and the solar-powered TLP2-SFB asset tracker. The IX-403-G combines a GPS receiver and a 4G LTE CAT1 cellular radio and delivers vehicle data to fleet managers. That page describes the IX-101-G as designed for the severe duty needs of on and off road commercial fleets. The ARC sensor is vehicle mounted and captures humidity, road and air temperatures on a remote in-cab display.

quote.text: PreCise MRM makes fleet management easy by providing solutions to your everyday obstacles.
